title: [PM seat] domain:ui · seat 2 — 🟢 os-warren · 由 os-warren 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 2**, opened on the maintainer's word to add a seat to the lane (「你现在就可以增加席位啊」, project chat, 2026-10-26). Seat 1 is #25966; seat 4 is #26620; seat 5 is #26945.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-warren` · 由 os-warren 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack ui", seat thread "Take a third ui lane seat") · `session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw` · seated 2026-10-28T00:30Z. The same project also sits seats 1 (#25966) and 5 (#26945) in separate seat threads; the three never claim the same card. Previous PM: `huangyiirene` · `session_01J8VVAkHqAv2eFKVSt9LqkC`, stood down 2026-10-28T00:08Z (brief 6456927674); before that `os-steve` (brief 6440315533).
- **File area (unchanged):** seat 2 = `ui/packages/` plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, fields, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report; plus auth (`ui/packages/auth`, console / app-shell auth pages), the Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 (#25966) = every other `domain:ui` path except seat 5's Interfaces carve (#26945). Epic #26676's territory stays out of this seat while its children are open. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#2`.
- **Model:** default judgment tier (Opus) under the quota exemption; no card whose order binds `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. A Tier H PR waits for the director seat's contract review and this seat's ACCEPT before any approver is asked (#26617).
- **Hot-file serial queue:** seat 2 holds no file. `AppNavInspector.tsx` (Setup) waits for seat 5's PR #26977 to land before this seat edits it. Read #25966's, #26620's and #26945's queues before any claim; ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay out of ui cards unless the maintainer approves.
- **Ledger carried:** #26649 (`Blocked-by: #26699`, closed) and #25873 (`Blocked-by: #26548`, closed) are `pm:blocked`; this seat re-derives each and releases it.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#2` + `head:claude/` PRs. Successor: `/pm-dispatch 接手`, read this post first.
- **Wall:** none.
